q: In post-streptococcal glomerulonephritis, the serum C3 is:
o: Low, returning to normal by 6–8 weeks
e: The C3 is low for a short time and returns to normal by 6–8 weeks.

q: Haematuria 1–2 days after a sore throat suggests:
e: Haematuria during the sore throat (synpharyngitic) suggests IgA nephropathy; post-streptococcal glomerulonephritis follows 1–2 weeks later.

q: Purpura on the buttocks with normal platelets and abdominal pain suggests:
e: Henoch–Schönlein purpura is an IgA vasculitis.

q: The best marker of a preceding streptococcal skin infection is:
e: The ASO rises only weakly after a skin infection.
